card.name: Linking words inside symptom lists
card.fires_on: Commas, hyphens and the word 'the' or 'general' in the middle of a warning-label sentence, mostly after a symptom name in a list (hypertonia, hypotension) or before 'population'.

modes.label: Comma after a symptom
modes.description: A comma right after one symptom in a list of adverse effects.
modes.example: There have been reports of agitation, hypertonia<<,>> hypotonia, tremor, som

modes.label: Word before a noun
modes.description: A small word such as 'general' that sits just before an expected noun like 'population'.
modes.example: The overall prevalence of sulfite sensitivity in the<< general>> population is unknown

modes.label: Hyphen in compound
modes.description: The hyphen inside 'life-threatening' in a warning sentence.
modes.example: anaphylactic symptoms and life<<-threatening>> or less severe asthmatic episodes in

card.plain: It fires on small connecting marks and words inside label sentences listing symptoms, where the next word is about to come.
